Armed Robbery at Jewelry Showroom in Bettiah, Bihar

In Bettiah, Bihar, armed robbers looted a Senco Gold & Diamond showroom of an estimated 40 crore rupees on Wednesday afternoon. Six to eight assailants reportedly held employees hostage, stole gold and cash, and assaulted one employee who resisted. The DIG and SSP visited the scene following the incident.
